catalysts.headline: Marvell announces agreement to acquire Lumentum (LITE) for ~$115B implied enterprise value in an all-stock deal (4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share)
catalysts.impact: Marvell shareholders to own ~67% of the combined company post-close; combined company targets >$1B in annual run-rate cost synergies; deal expected to close H1 2028. Marvell's own stock fell ~12.7% on the announcement day (Nov 2, 2026).
catalysts.source: Marvell/Lumentum joint press releases; Light Reading; SiliconANGLE; TechTarget

catalysts.headline: Marvell issues a preliminary Q3 FY2027 update alongside the Lumentum deal, narrowing its revenue guidance range from ±5% to ±2%
catalysts.impact: Signals confidence in hitting the prior ~$3.15B revenue midpoint guided with Q2 results; full results due with the Dec 1, 2026 earnings call.
catalysts.source: trade press (cross-referenced with Marvell's own conference-call announcement)

catalysts.headline: Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum (LITE) in an all-stock deal valuing Lumentum at roughly $115B enterprise value (~$102.5B equity value per Reuters-derived reporting); exchange ratio of 4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share; Marvell shareholders to own ~67% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis, Lumentum holders ~33%; Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston and two other Lumentum directors to join Marvell's board, Matt Murphy remains Chairman/CEO; combined company expects >$1B in annual run-rate cost synergies from the AI-driven shift from copper to optical connectivity; deal expected to close H1 2028 pending stockholder and regulatory approvals.
catalysts.impact: Reported by Bloomberg as the largest M&A deal of 2026 by equity value and the largest-ever in global tech excluding the SpaceX/xAI merger

catalysts.headline: Marvell shares fell 13.2% on reports it was closing in on a Lumentum buyout, ahead of the official announcement
Shares extended decline after the Oct 6, 2026 Investor Day

Shares extended their decline after the Oct 6 Investor Day, falling a cumulative 17.2% from Oct 9-16 (including an 8.7% single-session drop on Oct 14), attributed to broader AI-capex valuation concerns despite the raised FY2028 (~$20B) and new FY2031 ($70-90B) revenue targets announced at the event.
NYC Investor Day: raised FY2028 revenue outlook to ~$20B (from ~$18B) and set an FY2031 revenue target of $70B-$90B
catalysts.impact: Stock reportedly +5.81% on the session (intraday pop >11% reported by one source); not independently confirmed against a primary Marvell release

catalysts.headline: Filed a Form 424B7 resale prospectus supplement covering 146,504 shares offered by selling securityholders (not Marvell) tied to the February 2026 XConn Technologies acquisition -- a resale registration, not a new primary equity raise; Marvell receives no proceeds

Marvell filed a Form 424B7 resale prospectus supplement covering 146,504 shares of common stock offered by selling securityholders (not Marvell), tied to the February 2026 acquisition of XConn Technologies Holdings, Ltd.
catalysts.impact: This is a resale/secondary registration, not a new primary equity raise — Marvell receives no proceeds and this does not represent new dilutive capital-raising. Resolves the open question in the pre-existing record: the July 2026 prospectus did not price as a capital raise.
